content: Backup vs archive vs cache for CRDT/IPLD histories: cache = locally bounded, evictable copy (eviction is not deletion; miss must not imply logical absence); archive = durable off-node copy of immutable blocks, complete enough to rebuild causal history; backup = restorable snapshot of mutable state + metadata (IPFS Cluster: offline JSON state export/import, export+cleanup+import round-trip no-op; bytes re-fetched via pinning). Table-stakes ops across boxo/S5/Cluster: Put/PutMany, Get, Has, GetSize, enumerate/list (AllKeysChan / Store::list), Delete, explicit sync/durability barrier, verification on read (HashOnRead / BlobStore hash check / ValidatingBlockstore), status/progress reporting, and restore-to-local driven by an enumeration or manifest; export/import (CAR) is a common but separable later optimization.
